# Gnomad (see FORK.md). Gnomad's firmware releases, oldest first: "<release number> <INFO as the synth reports it>".
# The release site's manifest gives the build it is made from the next number (the highest here + 1) and lists every
# INFO here as "supersedes": the app offers Update only to a synth whose INFO is in that list, so a dev build, a
# downgrade or an unknown build is never offered one. When a signed release is published, add its line here.
